course.title: Unit 3 Work and play-Part B--【例句】
course.description: Part B（What do you do at the weekend?）

sentences.content: What do you usually do at the weekend, children?
sentences.english: What do you usually do at the weekend , children ?
sentences.chinese: 孩子们，你们周末通常做什么？

sentences.content: I often play football.
sentences.english: I often play football
sentences.chinese: 我经常踢足球。

sentences.content: Sometimes I play Chinese chess with my father.
sentences.english: Sometimes I play Chinese chess with my father
sentences.chinese: 有时我会和父亲下中国象棋。

sentences.content: That's nice.
sentences.english: That's nice
sentences.chinese: 那很好。

sentences.content: My mother works at the weekend, so I often cook lunch for my family.
sentences.english: My mother works at the weekend , so I often cook lunch for my family
sentences.chinese: 我母亲周末要工作，所以我经常为家人做午饭。

wordDetails.definition: work（第三人称单数）: 工作

sentences.content: Good girl! Does your mother work on Saturdays and Sundays?
sentences.english: Good girl ! Does your mother work on Saturdays and Sundays ?
sentences.chinese: 好姑娘！你妈妈周六周日上班吗？

sentences.content: Yes, she does.
sentences.english: Yes , she does
sentences.chinese: 是的，她确实如此。

sentences.content: I do my homework on Saturdays.
sentences.english: I do my homework on Saturdays
sentences.chinese: 我通常在星期六做家庭作业。

sentences.content: And I usually have pipa lessons on Sundays.
sentences.english: And I usually have pipa lessons on Sundays
sentences.chinese: 我通常在周日上琵琶课。

sentences.content: Great! Have a nice weekend, everyone!
sentences.english: Great ! Have a nice weekend , everyone !
sentences.chinese: 太棒了！祝大家周末愉快！
